signal_source: probe NEFF (teacache_mod_input_with_delta): on-device L2 norm of the block-0 modulated-input change vs the previous step (not rel-L1 -- the fit absorbs the scale)
target_rule: cadence 2's skip count at warmup/cooldown 5 (tp4tc2), so tp4tcad is compared at the same skip budget
calibration_prompts: a cat sitting on a bench in a sunlit park
a red vintage car parked outside a diner at dusk
an astronaut riding a horse across a desert plain
a bowl of ramen with steam rising, studio lighting
a lighthouse on a cliff during a thunderstorm
a robot barista pouring latte art in a cozy cafe
a snow-covered temple garden with stone lanterns
a macro photo of a dragonfly on a dewy leaf
